notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My first attempt to load the sources was rejected with a message saying I had no tool calls left for this turn. Because of that, I didn't read any pages: not Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit), StudyLight, Precept Austin, NET Bible, Bible Odyssey, or the Catholic and Orthodox sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and give a URL for every point. I've left the notes blank rather than writing them from memory.

If you start a new turn, I'll try again with this plan:

1. **Traditional reading:** the full chapter commentaries on enduringword.com, preceptaustin.org and studylight.org, plus Bible Hub's verse pages for 5:1–22 (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes, Keil & Delitzsch and others).
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** most likely at v. 7 (punished for the fathers' sins, compared with Ezek 18 and Jer 31:29–30), v. 19 (God reigns forever) and vv. 21–22 (restoration and grace, and how to translate the last line). I'd check Reformed sites (Ligonier, Monergism, TGC), Baptist ones (Spurgeon, Desiring God, GTY), Wesley's Notes, Lutheran sites (LCMS, 1517) and Pentecostal ones (Enduring Word, Sam Storms).
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes on vv. 7 and 22, Bible Odyssey on Lamentations, and Catholic and Orthodox sources (New Advent's Church Fathers, catholic.com, oca.org). I'd also look for anything the allowed sites say about popular modern teaching, such as prosperity teaching, in connection with this chapter.
